failed_or_abandoned: First lab-frame distribution added the solar velocity twice (observer velocity already contained v_sun before the Galactic shift): eta(0) 0.58x analytic and a spurious 1058 km/s edge; fixed by using w + v_orb as the heliocentric velocity.
One-year averaging mask initially covered June 2023-April 2024 (scan ends 1 April 2024), giving 249.8 km/s; fixed to 365.25 d from 27 March 2023 (252.11 km/s).
The 2 km/s speed grid cannot resolve the 1.1 km/s focusing shift of the hard edge; replaced by direction-scanned bisection (exact_edge).

astropy Time.ut1 raised a configuration error until iers.conf.auto_max_age was set explicitly (default None rejected by the config validator in this environment); offline overrides then worked with the bundled IERS-B table.
eta ratio at 790 km/s is infinite/undefined on dates when the unfocused edge is below 790 km/s; reported over the 23 finite dates and as the ratio of annual means.
